name: The Tome of Nobility
label: Quest
description: The Tome of Nobility: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, friend. I see your dedication remains strong, as does your faith.
I think it is time you spoke with Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. There are some more lessons for you to learn, and I feel you are prepared.
Seek him out in the Cathedral of Light, and friend, take these lessons seriously. You've attained your status through humility and hard work, do not disappoint us by becoming arrogant.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you've returned to the Cathedral, friend. Good. A lot has happened recently, and I would seek your aid if you prove worthy.
Many treacherous enemies are about. I will need your help to stop them.
